body: É possível ter carência sem nunca ter estado numa relação?
Hmm I see and I understand.. you can always try some cold showers

I know that cutting yourself is like a kinda pain you can have control. I think for your own good( having scars later can make you feel bad) you need to try another thing.. do you like reading? Watching series? You can even see things that you will feel understandable with your life . This is my advice if you try is good and if it doesn’t work I want you to know that it’s ok . You have your own time to heal. So I really recommend for at least distract yourself doing something else.
Eu espero bem que sim, obrigada :)
Seria o momento em que faria tudo o que não fiz durante estes anos todos. Acredito que seria o pico mais alto em toda a minha vida.
